alkylation_concentration.evidence: The free sulphydryls were then alkylated with 240mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The free sulphydryls were then alkylated with 240mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The proteins were then digest with Trypsin (Promega) at a protein:enzyme ratio of 10:1 overnight at 37°C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: trypsin used as the enzyme, CID/HCD as the fragmentation, 10ppm mass tolerances for the precursor, fragment, and library mass tolerances.

labeling.evidence: inferred: A DIA Chromatogram Library sample was created from a pooled aliquot of the samples.

reduction_concentration.evidence: The disulphides were reduced in 100mM dithiothreitol for 30 minutes at 37°C.

reduction_reagent.evidence: The disulphides were reduced in 100mM dithiothreitol for 30 minutes at 37°C.
